verdict.rationale: Calendly documents real-time webhooks that fire on schedule, cancel and reschedule events, with signing keys and a REST API, so bookings can be pushed into downstream systems programmatically. Routing also looks up Salesforce and HubSpot lead ownership and reports on HubSpot, Marketo and Pardot form conversions, and Calendly claims integrations that fold scheduling into existing workflows. However, the pack never shows bookings being written into CRM records natively, so the evidenced path requires building a custom webhook or API integration. Missing for 10: documented native sync of bookings into Salesforce/HubSpot records, any Zapier integration evidence, and hands-on corroboration of CRM sync.
